summary: Phantom provisional buffer restored on finalized provisional view after postback-reconciler repair
description:
Issue summary:
Customer reports that a provisional buffer credit line that had been marked 0 on their provisional invoice returned unexpectedly after we deployed a repair to the postback-reconciler service. Impact: customer-facing finance team saw a sudden credit line reappear in their provisional invoice view and requested clarification before finalization.

Impact:
- Internal risk: possible double-credit on final invoice if left unaddressed.
- Customer confusion and paused payout reconciliation.

Environment:
- prod-us-east (Acme HR org id: org-acme-778)
- Dedicated account on reserved capacity (enterprise contract)

Steps to reproduce (from customer's timeline):
1) 2026-03-09 02:15 UTC - Customer ran large scheduled batch (multi-model embed job) that previously failed partial postbacks and left hourly buffer suppressed.
2) 2026-03-10 05:40 UTC - Postback-reconciler team deployed a fix (GH-4832) intended to dedupe and re-ingest delayed postbacks.
3) 2026-03-10 06:12 UTC - Console provisional invoice view for Acme shows a +$0.00 (zeroed) hourly buffer previously missing now present again as a provisional credit line (non-zero).
4) Customer reports via support chat and asks for hold and explanation.

Observables / logs provided by customer:
- Console provisional invoice snapshot attached (attachment: provisional_2026-03-10.png).
- CSV of postback events for org-acme-778 between 2026-03-09T00:00 and 2026-03-10T12:00 (attachment: postbacks_acme_0309-0310.csv).
- Support replicate logs: reconciler stdout excerpt: "replay_count=1244, dedupe_mode=off, replay_worker=5"

Notes: customer is strongly requesting a correction before final invoice generation and wants confirmation that no refund/credit will be accidentally applied.
investigation_notes: 2026-03-10 07:10 - Triage by Maya: verified attachments; provisional view shows credit line ID PB-CR-4432 reappearing. Confirmed customer is dedicated enterprise with reserved-rate protections.

2026-03-10 08:00 - Reconciler SRE (Lars): inspected reconciler logs in prod-us-east; found a deployment 2026-03-10T05:40 that toggled dedupe_mode flag to 'off' due to a hotfix rollback script. This allowed older queued postbacks to be replayed without idempotency checks.

2026-03-10 08:30 - Query run against hourly_accumulator: discovered ~1,150 replayed postback rows inserted between 05:42 and 05:58 UTC for org-acme-778. Many entries correspond to warmup/hourly-buffer categories.

2026-03-10 09:05 - Billing analytics: provisional invoice generator consumed the backlog and applied buffer credits because the postbacks included hourly_buffer_tag and had rate tags attached. The provisional view therefore surfaced a credit line. Finalization not yet run.

2026-03-10 10:20 - Hypothesis: reconciler replayed backlog with dedupe disabled resulting in duplicate hourly buffer postbacks being visible to the provisional generator, restoring a previously-zeroed buffer. Not a double-charge yet, but would lead to over-credit if finalized.
2026-03-10 11:00 - Reproducer: re-run the provisional generator in a staging snapshot with and without the dedupe checks toggled reproduced the credit restoration behavior.
comments: 2026-03-10 07:25 - Maya Chen (Support): Thanks for the report, Acme team. We're investigating and will hold any automatic invoice finalization for your org until we confirm. Can you confirm you did not manually re-run the scheduled batch?

2026-03-10 07:40 - Jordan Patel (Acme finance): We did not re-run. We paused finalization once we saw the provisional change. Please advise next steps and whether the provisional figure is safe to ignore.

2026-03-10 08:10 - Lars Jensen (SRE): We observed a reconciler deployment that temporarily disabled dedupe_mode. We're running queries to enumerate replays and will scrub duplicates before finalization. Will provide a rollback or correction plan shortly.

2026-03-10 09:30 - Billing Analyst (Avery Lopez): If we're certain entries are duplicates we can issue an adjustment and provisional view will update. Need SRE confirmation of which postbacks to remove or mark ignored.

2026-03-10 11:30 - Lars Jensen (SRE): Plan: 1) mark replayed postbacks with tag 'replay-duplicate' for org-acme-778; 2) re-run provisional invoice generator in dry-run to verify credit lines; 3) schedule automatic scrub job to remove duplicates from the hourly_accumulator. Will target completion by 2026-03-11 04:00 UTC.
2026-03-11 02:45 - Maya Chen (Support): Update to customer: we've paused final invoice generation and SRE is scheduled to run the scrub. We'll notify you once provisional view is stable.
resolution_notes:
Mitigation applied 2026-03-11 03:50 UTC: SRE marked 1,148 postback rows as 'replay-duplicate' in hourly_accumulator for org-acme-778 and re-ran the provisional invoice generator in dry-run mode. Result: provisional credit line PB-CR-4432 reverted to previously-zeroed state in the console. No finalized invoice generated during window.

Customer outcome: Adjusted provisional view validated with Acme finance team. We applied a provisional credit hold to prevent accidental finalization. No refund was issued. Billing will not finalize the duplicate credit.

Root cause: A hotfix rollback to postback-reconciler inadvertently disabled dedupe checks, allowing delayed postbacks to be replayed and re-insert credit-bearing rows.

Permanent fix: follow-up internal tasks created: INT-9921 (add safe-guard that prevents dedupe_flag=false in production without explicit feature-toggle approval) and INT-9922 (idempotency enforcement for replay workers). Patch GH-4850 prepared to harden reconciler; scheduled for canary deploy 2026-03-15.

Compensation: No automatic billing adjustment needed since duplicates were scrubbed pre-finalization. Customer requested a written apology and a one-time account credit of $150 for operational impact; billing approved credit on 2026-03-12 and applied as account-level adjustment (see billing note BN-2026-118200).
follow_up_actions: INT-9921 - Feature-toggle approval guard for reconciler deploys (owner: SRE)
INT-9922 - Idempotency enforcement for replay workers (owner: Core Infra)
Create Confluence runbook entry documenting steps to pause invoice finalization during large reconciler replays (owner: Billing)
Notify customers in affected org list and add monitoring alert for unexpected provisional-credit restores (owner: Support)
Schedule GH-4850 canary and rollback verification on 2026-03-15
public_reply: Hi Jordan — thanks for the report and for pausing finalization. We found that a reconciler rollback temporarily disabled a dedupe check which replayed delayed postbacks and restored an hourly buffer credit in your provisional view. We have scrubbed the duplicate postbacks and confirmed the provisional view now matches the expected balance. No finalized invoice was affected. We've applied a small account credit for the disruption and will follow up with a short report and next steps. If you’d like we can walk through the CSV we used to validate the scrub. — Maya, Redwood Support
